original.statement: The `-compactor.delete-request-store` CLI flag or its YAML configuration setting must be explicitly configured when retention is enabled in Loki 3.0.0, as it is required for storing delete requests.

corrected.statement: When retention is enabled, -compactor.delete-request-store (or its YAML setting delete_request_store) must now be explicitly configured; it is required for storing delete requests.

decision.reason: [ev-e598abf2a6cd] says `-compactor.delete-request-store` (or its YAML setting) should be explicitly configured when retention is enabled and is required for storing delete requests, so now-required is the right change type. The flag name is spelled with a single leading dash, so it stays exactly as written. The text never names the compactor as a component that owns the flag. "compactor" only appears inside the flag name, so the component field should be left out.
